    A FIELD GUIDE TO THE BITCOIN ECONOMY

    It starts with
    a cup of coffee.

    Inspired by Bitcoin Magazine’s October 19, 2026 story about friends paying with bitcoin at Pita Cafe and Echo Coffee, this map started with the article’s 219 Arizona merchants. It now explores Bitcoin businesses across all 50 states and Washington, DC.

    Browse, save a few favorites, and make a day of it. Bitcoin works best when you get to use it.

    Each place shows its source: a merchant statement, recent community verification from BTC Map / OpenStreetMap, a maintainer review, or the original Arizona article. New community additions require a verification date within 12 months and a complete address. Source checks are not test purchases. This sourced directory cannot guarantee every business or current acceptance. Some pins are US Census address-range estimates.
    Read the original story

    Free and open source. No account required. Saved places stay in this browser. If location permission is already granted, we attempt a nearby view on arrival. Otherwise use the location button, choose a city or ZIP, or set a map point. Precise starting locations are kept in memory; shared trails include business IDs only. Road previews use the public OSRM service; navigation opens Google Maps.
